Hong Kong Mothers of Multiples

Hi,

There is a group called "Hong Kong Mothers of Multiples".

They have a website here:

http://www.hkmoms.com/

They seem to have get-togethers, swap meets, etc.

My older sister in the USA has quads and she found her multiples club to be a great source of information and support.

I am a working mum and from M-F daytime, I leave my gals + boy to my maid + my parents (my parents have moved to the flat next to mine and so they used to take care my children all day) and when I back home by 6 and settled down, start to play with my son + gals... my son likes story telling, singing and so during lunch hour, I like to visit those children bookshop and look for some interesting books for them.

I like to join mom's gathering too... actually I met some moms whose son/daughter are of similar age to mine... and we share what we face in work/ children... and we do go PGs together... very happy.

posts.body:
Congratulations.

My case is quite similar to you, when my twin gals born, my son was only 2 yrs 3 months old. Yes, you must seek help coz taking care twins is not easy. Luckily in HK you can hire some expert baby sitters to help you, surely you can instruct your maid to take care of your son and you can spare the time to take care the babies together witht he baby sitter.

As long as you plan the routine/schedule in advance, you won't have much trouble... my twins are now 6 months old and start weaning already. 

Happy to share with you.

posts.body:
Wow November? I had my twins two years ago in November. And yes I was panicked! hahahahhaa

There's http://www.moms-hongkong.com/ which will restart in September but do send an email out to them now, everyone there is very kind and understanding and 90% of the mums have twins (yes there are a few triplets plus some mums even have two sets of twins....)

I also visit a website in USA which is great for support and information:

http://www.twinstuff.com/

I love the forums - perfect for when you have a question and want an answer within 24 hours. 

Its also cool to hang out with other pregnant ladies (they dont have to be carrying multiples!). When I was pregnant I visited the due dates forum here, yours is located at:

http://www.geobaby.com/forum/forum67.html

and met other pregnant ladies. Luckily in our group there was 3 of us carrying twins (all different versions - 2 boys, 2 girls and one of each) however the whole group still keeps in touch even though our babies are nearly 2. Give it a go!
